title: QA Pilot Review Depth Threshold
description: Schema for a bounded advisory review-depth threshold evaluation. Classifies evidence completeness and consistency depth for Owner review guidance. Does not auto-accept, auto-reject, execute work, approve intake, verify evidence, close items, mutate the chain, or seal anything. Owner remains the final decision point.

source_evidence_context.description: Reference to the evidence context evaluated for depth.

threshold_state.description: Advisory depth classification. sufficient = evidence depth adequate for Owner review. needs_more_context = gaps found, additional evidence recommended before Owner review. blocked = critical gaps prevent meaningful Owner review.

authority_disclaimer.const: This review-depth threshold evaluation is advisory-only. It does not auto-accept evidence, auto-reject findings, execute work, approve intake, verify evidence, close workbench items, mutate the evidence chain, or seal anything. Owner remains the final decision point. Custody is qa-pilot-local. Librarian impact is none.
